layouts.description: Draft configuration: Original course using the short eastern closing corner; excludes the later extended eastern loop. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3031.1 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
